name: session-progress
description: A Progress pane beside the chat that shows how the session's work is going: goal, tickets, time left, and what needs you.

whileQuestionWaits.title: While a question waits
whileQuestionWaits.description: What Claude does while a question in the Progress pane has no answer: stop and wait, work around it on tickets that do not depend on the answer, or keep building on its recommended option.
